title: Ex9 - Code: Temperature line plot
text:
Using the temperature dataset, create a time series line plot (no markers, only a line) using ax.plot_date() with linestyle='-' and marker='None'.

Dataset is already loaded as dfTemp with columns: timestamp, temperature.
answer:
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16,10))
ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
ax.plot_date(dfTemp['timestamp'], dfTemp['temperature'], color='black', linestyle='-', marker='None')
plt.title('Temperature readings at different times')
plt.xlabel('Time')
plt.ylabel('Temperature')
